cases.label: tool_envelope • invalid_args is the validation-error kind (retryable)
notes: note: The validation-error failure kind. Unlike tool_not_found / rejected / user_denied (terminal), invalid_args defaults to retryable=true: the arguments are malformed but the model can fix them and call again. Pins both the discriminator and that retryable default so a future change can't silently flip it.

cases.label: tool_envelope • a policy rejection is non-retryable
notes: note: Policy refusal — the registry blocked the tool by configuration. Distinct from user_denied (interactive deny) and from the retryable kinds: retryable defaults to false because retrying the same call hits the same policy, so the model must pivot rather than loop.
envelope: {"ok":false,"kind":"rejected","message":"Tool `shell_run` is disabled by policy in this session.","retryable":false,"tool":"shell_run"}

cases.label: tool_envelope • timeout failures default to retryable=true
tool_envelope • failure(toolNotFound) carries the right discriminator
notes: envelope: {"ok":false,"kind":"tool_not_found","message":"Tool 'browse' is not available in this session.","retryable":false,"tool":"browse"}
